papers.title: Latent Reasoning with Normalizing Flows (NF-CoT)
papers.authors: Tu, Fu, Yu, Tang, Kang, Qin, Zhang, Gu
papers.what: Normalizing flows inside the LLM backbone replace discrete CoT with compact continuous thoughts; improves pass rates on code generation with ~4x fewer reasoning tokens.

papers.title: MemoPilot: Test-Time Learning of LLM Agents via RL over Memory
papers.what: Trainable memory copilot for frozen LLM agents; multi-turn GRPO over the memory-update process achieves top Elo on sequential game benchmarks.

papers.title: Bridging the Last Mile of Time Series Forecasting with LLM Agents
papers.what: LLM agent wraps around TS foundation model forecasts and applies structured revisions using business context retrieved via tool calls.

papers.title: ExpWeaver: LLM Agents Learn from Experience via Latent RAG
papers.what: End-to-end latent-space experience retrieval for LLM agents; eliminates text-based RAG overhead via hidden-state encoding and cross-attention.
